title: AI Could Draft a Cybercrime Complaint? The Important Catch #shorts
description:
Samarthan, reported among the Build What Moves India hackathon prototypes, explored helping organize cybercrime evidence into a draft report. It's NOT the official reporting channel and has not been independently validated for privacy or accuracy. Never hand over passwords, OTPs or sensitive evidence to untrusted AI apps. For real cybercrime reports in India, use https://www.cybercrime.gov.in/. For immediate financial cyber fraud, call the official 1930 helpline promptly.

Would you trust AI to help draft your report, YES or NO? Verify every detail.
